finding: AmmMarket.addLiquidity reverts ExchangeRateBelowOne when SY exchangeRate != exactly 1 WAD at first seed
cause: Short (1800s) bond accrues valuePerUnit every second; seed ran 263s after startingDate because START_DELAY_SECONDS=120 elapsed during the ~380s deploy broadcast. AMM initialization sets rateAnchor=initialAnchor(1e18) and _getExchangeRateOrPanic reverts on exchangeRate<WAD, so any positive SY rate drift makes the first addLiquidity revert.
mainMarketWhyItPassed: 90-day term: valuePerUnit/coupon change by 0 within the seconds between deposit and addLiquidity, so syRate stayed exactly 1.
workaroundUsed: Redeploy with START_DELAY_SECONDS large enough that seed completes before startingDate.
contractOwner: Codex 1 (AMM anchor should scale with syRate; this is an integration finding, not patched here).
